title: Scalar compatibility of canonical exchange
statement:
Fix universes u and w, a prime natural number l, and an algebraic closure Ω : Type w of ℚ_[l], with its given field and algebra structures. Let X, Y, X', Y' be schemes in universe u, each Noetherian and of finite topological Krull dimension, with l invertible in every stalk. Write dT and iT for the respective dimension and invertibility witnesses for each scheme T. All preservation hypotheses, functors, comparisons and conclusions are quantified exactly as follows.

theorem pbcExchangeCompatibleFamily
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    (presRf : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
      (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω X E),
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((pbcActualDerivedPush f (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj))
    (presRf' : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
      (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω X' E),
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((pbcActualDerivedPush f' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj))
    (presLg : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
      (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω Y E),
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((pbcActualCompletedPull g (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj))
    (presLg' : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
      (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω X E),
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete X' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((pbcActualCompletedPull g' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj))
    (Rf : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out))
    (Rf' : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X' dX'.out iX'.out)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y' dY'.out iY'.out))
    (Lg : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y' dY'.out iY'.out))
    (Lg' : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X' dX'.out iX'.out))
    (hRf : ∀ E, Rf.Φ E = pbcDescentDirectImage l Ω f presRf E)
    (hRf' : ∀ E, Rf'.Φ E = pbcDescentDirectImage l Ω f' presRf' E)
    (hLg : ∀ E, Lg.Φ E = pbcDescentPullback l Ω g presLg E)
    (hLg' : ∀ E, Lg'.Φ E = pbcDescentPullback l Ω g' presLg' E)
    (bRf : PbcDirectImageBetaSpec l Ω f presRf Rf)
    (bRf' : PbcDirectImageBetaSpec l Ω f' presRf' Rf')
    (bLg : PbcPullbackBetaSpec l Ω g presLg Lg)
    (bLg' : PbcPullbackBetaSpec l Ω g' presLg' Lg') :
    ∃ Ex : StageSystem.Morphism.Hom (Rf.comp Lg)
          (Lg'.comp Rf'),
        (∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
          (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω X E),
          HEq ((Ex.τ E).app (ScalarLocalization.mk K))
            ((pbcStageLocalization l Ω Y' E).map
              (ObjectProperty.homMk
                (X := (pbcConditionalIntegral (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
                  (pbcActualCompletedPull g (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)) (presLg E)).obj
                    ((pbcConditionalIntegral (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
                      (pbcActualDerivedPush f (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)) (presRf E)).obj K))
                (Y := (pbcConditionalIntegral (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
                  (pbcActualDerivedPush f' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)) (presRf' E)).obj
                    ((pbcConditionalIntegral (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
                      (pbcActualCompletedPull g' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)) (presLg' E)).obj K))
                ((pbcActualCompletedExchange (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E) sq).app K.obj))))

Here the category, scalar system, operation functors, and canonical BetaSpec are those of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category], [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport] and [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. The exact-family and actual rational-pullback interfaces are [def-weil-pbc-descent-interfaces]; the actual rational direct image and its beta predicate are [def-per-rational-direct-image-family].

proof.text: Restrict the ambient actual completed exchange to the four integral full subcategories by ObjectProperty.homMk. Its naturality follows by ObjectProperty.hom_ext from the ambient naturality equation. Apply ScalarLocalization.transportNat, using transport_comp and equality conjugation to obtain a transformation between the two composites of rational operations. Its integral components are the localized actual exchange components. Conjugate by the four given stage-functor equalities, retaining this component formula by heterogeneous equality. Apply the separately stated scalar-square law to these natural transformations and assemble StageSystem.Morphism.Hom.

proof_origin.place: Explicit restriction, rationalization, conjugation and Hom assembly; the scalar square is extracted separately, 2026-10-22.

split_report.summary: Proved construction of the stage exchange and its compatible-family assembly from the separate scalar-square law. This theorem has no retained sorry.
split_report.blueprint: Serves the final operations/exchange sentence of prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors; the general descent and the unit route remain. Searches of the whole blueprint for scalar-compatible and exchange maps find the parent proposition and more specialized exchange nodes, but no separate equivalent statement.
split_report.edge_cases: Identity morphisms, empty schemes, repeated coefficient fields, independently sized coefficient algebraic closures, and proof-irrelevant preservation witnesses keep the same statement.
